descriptions: The last wall, and a gate tied shut with twine. Beyond it the heather runs away in every direction to the sky.
features: A stone post with a hand carved on it, pointing nowhere in particular.
ambient: A grouse goes up from under your feet, cackling.

descriptions: Knee-deep heather, springy and tangled, humming with bees.
Heather burnt black in strips, with green shoots coming through.
A brake of gorse, yellow-flowered and wickedly spiked. Tufts of wool hang on every thorn.
features: A path tunnelled through the gorse, low and narrow. Something uses it.
ambient: The gorse pods crack in the sun.

descriptions: A heap of stones on a rise, each one added by somebody passing.
A tall cairn, leaning, with a view over half the moor.
features: A stone with a name scratched into it, and a date.
ambient: The wind whistles through the cairn.

descriptions: A peaty brown beck tumbling over stones, cold enough to ache.
A deep cleft with a beck at the bottom and ferns on the walls.
features: A plank bridge, missing its middle plank.
ambient: The water chatters over the stones.

descriptions: A ruined summer hut of turf and stone, where herders lived when the flocks were up.
Four tumbled walls and a hearthstone, still blackened.
features: A broken churn in the corner.
